description: Call before installing an npm or PyPI package: latest or given version, licence, OSV vulns, CISA KEV CVEs, deprecation or yank. Returns ok, caution or block.

name.description: Package name, e.g. express, requests; a scoped npm name is URL-encoded in the path (%40types%2Fnode)

project_license.description: Your project licence, one SPDX id (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-only) or proprietary; default proprietary

use.description: How the package is used: distribute (default), saas or internal

version.description: The version to judge: an exact version (e.g. 2.31.0) or an npm dist-tag; default the latest. Unknown version 404

name: stackfacts_package_preflight
